laws.rule: Mu Ko Similan National Park closes to tourism and overnight stays every monsoon season; in 2026 it was closed from 16 May to 14 October and reopened on 15 October.

layers.authority: Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (as reported by the Tourism Authority of Thailand)
layers.process: Marine national parks in Phang Nga, including Mu Ko Similan, Mu Ko Surin and Ao Phang Nga (Phang Nga Bay), have used electronic entry tickets since October 2025. TAT advises buying the ticket in advance and having your passport ready.

layers.authority: Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation
layers.process: Mu Ko Similan National Park closes for about five months over the monsoon each year. TAT reports it reopened on 15 October 2026. The Surin Islands, home of the Moken sea people, are reached by a long boat trip; TAT describes visits to the Moken as small-scale and community-led.

festivals.what: Phang-nga Loi Krathong Festival 2026: 19 to 28 November 2026 at Somdet Phra Srinagarindra Park, Phang Nga town, an extended version of the province's annual Loi Krathong celebrations.

moving_calendars: Loi Krathong: full moon of the 12th Thai lunar month (re-dated each year).
